text:
ashley (product): Flagging a VelaCare security questionnaire that just arrived via sales. They want SOC2 evidence + 7-year audit log retention. Can we scope this quickly?
sophia (security): thanks for flagging. quick skim: SOC2 section is standard but they want immutable audit logs for 7yrs and a separate data-retention enclave for PHI.
mike (support): VelaCare is a mid-market healthtech trialing Dedicated. They're pushing this as a gating item for procurement. Lena can confirm SLA ask.
lena (sales): yep, procurement call tomorrow. If we can't commit to 7yr logs for Dedicated we lose deal. They asked for a signed note about retention guarantees.
juan (eng): technical note: our current audit log pipeline stores logs in S3 with 1 year lifecycle + 3yr cold archive. 7yrs is possible but needs lifecycle policy changes + KMS rotation policy and extra cost. Also need retention-exempt deletion guardrails for customers.
sophia (security): we also need to validate if the logs include token-level data. For HIPAA we need ensure ePHI isn't leaked into logs. Can we provide a sanitized audit export?
ashley (product): acceptance criteria proposal: 1) documented retention SLAs for Dedicated up to 7yrs, 2) exportable audit bundle with PII redaction, 3) product page + contract clause draft. P0 for this customer? vote please. :thinking_face: 
juan (eng): technically P1 unless sales confirms it's a blocker today. Est effort: 3 sprints to expand retention + KMS handling + infra QA.
lena (sales): It's blocking procurement. They gave deadline EOW next week. If our legal signs a time-limited attestation we might get a bridge.
sophia (security): Can we offer a mitigated option: 3yr hot + 4yr cold with WORM (write-once) flag and customer-managed keys? That reduces infra churn but meets 7yr effective retention.
juan (eng): WORM with S3 Object Lock + CMKs is feasible, but needs changes to our deploy templates and backup restore flows. Also add cost estimate: +~$8k/mo at scale X.
ashley (product): ok proposal sounds reasonable. Action items: - Sophia to draft security mitigations + attestation text - Juan to propose infra changes + rough timeline and cost - Mike to collect exact procurement wording from VelaCare - Lena to ask if they'll accept a bridge attestation.
compliance-bot: New ticket created: RB-2389 "VelaCare retention scope: 7yr audit logs + PHI enclave options". Assignees: ashley, juan, sophia. Link: https://redwood.example/tickets/RB-2389
mike (support): VelaCare procurement reply: they can accept a signed attestation + implementation within 90 days. They want the attestation to state: "Redwood will retain immutable audit logs for customer workloads for 7 years using WORM or equivalent."
sophia (security): i'll draft attestation but need legal signoff. also need to confirm how redaction works and what we can promise for ePHI.
juan (eng): timeline update: sprint 1 (infra design + KMS), sprint 2 (S3 lifecycle + WORM), sprint 3 (QA + e2e export). That's ~6-8 weeks. Cost estimate in ticket.
ashley (product): decision: mark RB-2389 P0 for VelaCare deal, but record as conditional: attestation signed -> 90-day implementation window. We'll ship canary with dedicated customers first.
lena (sales): I'll send attestation draft to procurement today and push for conditional signature. :crossed_fingers:
mike (support): I'll add the procurement thread to the ticket. Anything else?
sophia (security): one more ask: require monthly integrity checks for archived logs and an audit checklist for customers. I'll add to ticket.
ashley (product): great. closing thread for now — we'll update RB-2389 with timeline and acceptance criteria. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
